title: OWASP LLM Top 10 · 2025
summary: Map findings to the correct edition of the OWASP risks.
html:
This is the 2025 taxonomy. Identifiers from earlier editions can refer to different risks; always record the edition in a finding.

LLM07:2025System Prompt Leakageprompt output
LLM08:2025Vector and Embedding Weaknessesretrieval
LLM09:2025Misinformationassessment
LLM10:2025Unbounded Consumptioninfrastructure

A category is a reporting aid, not proof of vulnerability or an exam scoring rule. Explain the violated boundary, observed effect, and mitigation separately.
